defs.def: how large, important, serious, etc. sth is 程度；限度

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

ex.s: Many people thought she didn’t live up to Helen’s title of “the most beautiful woman in the world”, influencing opinions of the movie to some extent.
ex.t: 许多人认为她配不上海伦“世上最美丽的女人”的称号，这在某种程度上影响了人们对这部电影的看法。

ex.s: But to what extent can we justify telling white lies like these?
ex.t: 但像这样的善意谎言，我们能为它们辩护到什么程度呢？

ex.s: Many misconceptions about China are to some extent the result of miscommunication.
ex.t: 许多关于中国的误解，在某种程度上是沟通不畅造成的。

ex.s: They be able to help to some extent.
ex.t: 他们在某种程度上也许能帮上忙。

ex.s: We need to do something now to protect the sea.” Plastic waste in the sea has long been known about, but only now are we discovering the true extent of the problem.
ex.t: 我们现在需要采取行动来保护海洋。”海洋中的塑料废弃物早已为人所知，但直到现在，我们才意识到问题的真正严重程度。

defs.def: the physical size of an area 大小；面积；范围
